newsitem.title: ALBANIA: Polio outbreak in Albania claims 15th victim.
newsitem.headline: Polio outbreak in Albania claims 15th victim.

text.p: A 14-year-old boy has died of polio in Albania, the 15th victim of the outbreak, an Albanian daily said on Thursday.
The boy from a village in the district of Librazhd, 80 km (50 miles) east of Tirana, died on Sunday after being treated for three months in hospital, the Gazeta Shqiptare reported.
The polio outbreak has infected 137 people since April. Albanian health authorities, aided by international organisations, launched a nationwide immunisation campaign in October.
"There are no new cases since November 12," doctor Kristo Pano at the infectious diseases hospital in Tirana told Reuters.
Health ministry officials were unavailable for comment.
